propositions: Rebar ticket-wordlist.txt is byte-identical to DSO plugin source at revision 8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956, establishing immediate provenance.
No primary source records an antecedent corpus, retrieval location, or generation method for the wordlist entries, leaving antecedent provenance unresolved.
DSO project carried Apache License 2.0 at the final wordlist revision, and the license was copied verbatim to Rebar, but this does not establish terms governing an antecedent corpus.
Coolname and adjective-adjective-animal repositories are disproven as exact byte sources by SHA-256 and distinctive-entry comparison.
GitHub code search for filename and distinctive word combinations returned no external matches, but negative results do not prove originality.
No repository correction is supported by available evidence; adding attribution or corpus-specific license would overstate the record.
